description: This file defines a custom Symfony form type class 'MarkdownType' for editing Markdown content within forms. It extends a base textarea type and adds functionality to convert HTML to Markdown for display and editing purposes.

classes.name: MarkdownType
classes.description: A Symfony form type for Markdown editing, extending the TextareaType, with custom buildView logic for Markdown content.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Customizes the form view by converting HTML to Markdown if the field is not disabled and contains HTML tags.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent form type class, which is TextareaType.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix used in form theming, set to 'markdown'.
